examples.english_translation: Smartphones are having a great influence on the lives of modern people.

examples.english_translation: I believe that you will definitely pass the exam.

examples.english_translation: You shouldn't believe that all the information on the internet is real.

examples.korean_sentence: 문이 무거우니까 손으로 세게 밀어서 여세요.
examples.english_translation: The door is heavy, so push it hard with your hand to open it.

examples.english_translation: South Korea has developed greatly economically over the past few decades.

examples.korean_sentence: 두 사람의 관계가 좋은 방향으로 발전하고 있어요.
